control_failures.control_label: guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: prohibition notice - work stopped during a planned shutdown on MAG-9602

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control BLAST_GUARDING_AND_CLEARANCE: the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast on MAG-9602 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in storing and transporting explosives, specifically receiving, magazining and reconciling explosives. MAG-9602 (explosives magazines) is in service for explosives and detonator storage. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 10 December 2013 a regulatory notice was issued concerning MAG-9602 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop following a planned shutdown.
